The portrait (or unit frame) is a screen UI element that represents a "unit" (player character, mob, or NPC). It can include a name, portrait, status bar or some other element related to the unit. ;Character Portrait: Shows your character name, face, level, and health bar. Depending on your class, the second bar could be your mana, rage, energy, focus bars or a special secondary resource. ;Target Portrait: Shows the name, face, and health bar of any creature or character you click on in the game. Depending on the target, it might also have a mana, rage, or energy bar. ;Pet Portrait: Some character classes can summon pets. If such a character is currently controlling a pet, a pet portrait app

Also known as 'Server Population', 'Server Pop' or just 'Pop', this term refers server population. Depending on the context, the following populations are generally considered: * Current number of players online. * Total number of players on or offline. * Total number of possible player characters. * Total number of charachters created on the realm(that still exist) Blizzard uses some unknown method to determine population on their [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/serverstatus/ Realm Status page], but the status indicator:

Poor is the lowest level of item quality, below common. * The names of poor quality items will appear in gray. * Equippable items of poor quality usually have no attribute bonuses or stats besides basic Armor or Damage. Only new characters will find these items useful. * Poor quality items cannot be disenchanted. * Poor quality items are often called "Vendor Trash", "Junk", or simply "grays". * Except for equippable items, readable items, and , poor quality items have no use and can safely be sold to vendors. * Poor quality items are rarely given as quest rewards. *: There are only 6 quest reward items, see [http://www.wowhead.com/?items&filter=qu=0;cr=18;crs=1;crv=0 Wowhead] for details. *

The Pools of Vision are located within a tunnel system just below the cap of Spirit Rise, and serve as the Forsaken base of operations at Thunder Bluff. The entrance to pools of vision is at the right-hand side of the bridge from low rise to spirit rise. The end of the bridge is at , and the entrance to the cave is at . You can fish the waters here; the catches are the same for all the major cities except for Dalaran.

Polymorph Clones are sheep found in Azshara. They are created when a mage carrying a Prismatic Shell polymorphs Spitelash naga. After a few seconds, the polymorphed naga will split into several small clones. The clones are fast, have very little health, and disappear quickly.

Porcine Entourage was a boar that roamed with Princess in the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest. Attacking it would aggro Princess as well, and vice versa. This pig doesn't appear to have followed Princess when she moved to the Stonefield Farm.

Portal Hounds were fel beasts summoned by Invading Voidwalkers at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands during the Dark Portal Opens event, fighting NPCs behind the frontline. They cause Fire Damage to attackers, making them deadly for melee combatants.

__NOTOC__ Poobah's Nose Ring is an mail wrist armor. It gives a bonus to stamina. This is Princess Poohbah's nose ring.

The Pools of Jin'Alai is a frozen pool located south of Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

These heavy and expensive items are still used mainly by milliary officers and wealthy merchants, though there are many tinkers laboring to create a version for mass production. A portable kitchen is the size of a and shape of a barrel. A phlogiston-amplified steam engine built into the base heats a small oven in its midsection and the kettle underneath the cover atop it. Cooking bread or stew with the portable kitchen is as simple as adding the mixed ingredients to the appropriate compartment, using a lever to set the heat to the proper level, and watching the clock count down the minutes until food is prepared.

Portable heads are compact repositories of knowledge. Though they could likely take on any outward appearance, tinkers with capricious sense of humor usually build them in the form of the heads of various creatures (and often in the form of their own heads). All portable heads know at least one language, in order to understand spoken commands. The most common portable heads are those with a second language installed in order to act as translators. After being activated, the translator listens to what is being said and then speaks. , a type found on the Dragon Isles.]] Porcupines, also known as hedgehogs or quillrats, are huge, quilled rodents found on Pandaria, making their first appearance with the World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria expansion. Porcupine quills are sometimes used for ornamental purposes, and can be sold for a good price. Many believe that the quillrat is able to shoot its spines at aggressors. Although the wounds caused by the young quillrat are seldom fatal, most predators seek easier prey.
The Pool of Reflection is a deep pool found within the Singing Pools of the Wandering Isle. It's here the ancient water spirit, Shu, sulks after Old Man Liang stopped visiting him.
The Pool of the Paw is a small pool shaped like the paw of a tiger located in the Pei-Wu Forest of the Wandering Isle.

The Pools of Purity are small special ponds found just north of New Cifera in north-central Valley of the Four Winds. These pools nurture life like nothing else in Pandaria. Pandaren Lotus Farmers have been growing flowers here, however, recently toads have moved in and began spawning like crazy and becoming a real problem for the farmers. Dragon turtles have noticed that abundance of toads and have also been causing trouble in the pools, trampling the lotuses and snapping at the workers. Zhang Yue is in charge of collecting the flowers and transporting them to the village below. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Desecrator Ma'veth arrived here, setting the area in felflame and kil
Pookie is a house cat located at Ella's farm in the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The Pools of Youth can be found in the northeastern reaches of the Ruins of Dojan in central Krasarang Wilds. This pool was used during the mogu empire to extend the lives of the mogu, however, it did not always end well for those that drank the waters. The waters from the Pools of Youth does not create life, rather, it siphons life energy from those who drink from it and it transfers that life energy. Lorekeeper Vaeldrin sacrificed his life energy to bring his daughter back from the dead by drinking from the waters, transferring his life energy to her. The pool is guarded by Na Lek.

|250px]] Poop quests are a recurring type of quest in World of Warcraft that involves excrement, usually in the form of sifting through animal droppings to retrieve one or several items. A long-standing tradition, poop quests appeared in one form or another in every expansion except which had an achievement instead. According to humor site , "World of Warcraft has more poop-related quests than any other MMO, excluding the niche fetish games Pooptopia and Fecesquest." introduced the most of any other expansion, at ten quests total.
Pollous the Fetid is a water elemental located in Val'sharah.

The Portal to Dalaran is a portal that is available at the Light's Hammer in Icecrown Citadel. It takes the user to the Northrend Dalaran.
Poole's Cutting is located in Boralus. The establishment is owned by Daniel Poole.
The Porcine-Warlord's Legplates drop from Warlord Ramtusk in Razorfen Kraul.
Polluted Viseclaw Fries are crabs located in Krasarang Wilds.
Polluted Viseclaw Meat drops from Polluted Viseclaw Fries, Polluted Viseclaws, and Polluted Viseclaw Scuttlers in Krasarang Wilds.
Polluted Viseclaw Scuttlers are crabs located in Krasarang Wilds.

Addons for Retail will in most cases work on Classic with removal of any non-Classic API. If you don't have an error handling addon, get [https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bugsack BugSack] or [https://auctioneeraddon.com/ Swatter] or enable CVar . See also Patch 1.13.2/API changes.

The Port Authority is building located in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor. It is from here, that Dockmaster Cobo oversees the logistics of the Port of Zandalar.
The Possessed Package is found hiding in mailboxes throughout the Vision of Orgrimmar and Vision of Stormwind.
Portable Revealing Occular is provided as an objective for Don't Stalk Me, Troll (Alliance).
Portal Keeper's Cincture drops from Portal Keeper Hasabel in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Portal Masters are n'raqi located in the Mage Quarter in the Vision of Stormwind.
Portalkeeper Jin'tashal is a jungle troll located in the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
Portal Combat is a dungeons & raids achievement earned by defeating Portal Keeper Hasabel in Antorus, the Burning Throne after opening a chaotic rift on Normal difficulty or higher.

Possessed Fae are faeries located in Heartwood Grove and Blackthorn Grove in Ardenweald.
Popular Pupil's Mitts are a quest reward from Plague is Thicker Than Water.
Possessed Spies are sylvar located in Hibernal Hollow in Ardenweald.
Portable Micro-Maw Cannons are created with Engineering (60); taught by trainers. This item was replaced by the Gravimetric Scrambler Cannon.

The Pool of Mixed Monstrosities is located just south of Plague Watch at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. Foul-Tongue Cyrlix uses it to mix concoctions for his research and has asked for adventurers' aid in gathering the ingredients. Three types of "Oozing Ingredients" can be gathered from nearby slime creatures and added to the pool: Viscous Oil, Mephitic Goo, and Miscible Ooze. After 30 Oozing Ingredients have been added, a monstrosity will spawn. The first monstrosity killed per day counts as a rare mob. There are seven possible monstrosities; which one appears depends on the combination of ingredients used. Cecil Chiobrix provides clues as to the possible results.
Pollen Your Weight is a potential daily quest available after activating the Anima Conductor to the Eternal Forge.
The Portal to Forlorn Respite is located in the Tremaculum in the Maw. The portal is created by Jaina Proudmoore. It leads back to the Forlorn Respite.
The Possibility Matrix is sold by Ve'nari for 1525x Stygia at her refuge in the Maw for players with a Appreciative standing with her.

The Portal to Torghast is found in Ve'nari's Refuge in the Maw once players unlock it during Into Torghast. Alts will see it as soon as they reach level sixty. Run through it to enter the antechamber of Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Others are found throughout the Maw.
Portal to the Nexus is found in the Nexus Vault during The Nexus Vault (mage).
The Pool of Judgment is a pool in the Warden's Court of the Vault of the Wardens. Its waters let the user gaze into the past in order to better judge someone for their actions.
Portable Pocket Dimension is a 32-slot bag dropped by Artificer Xy'mox within Castle Nathria.
__NOTOC__ Possessed Grovetenders are sylvar located in the Grove of Awakening in Ardenweald.
__NOTOC__ Possessed Chargers are sylvar located in Soryn's Meadow in Ardenweald.
The Pommel Jewel of Remornia summons the Will of Remornia companion. The item drops from Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria.
Porous Stone Statues are created with Shadowlands Jewelcrafting (50); taught by Design: Porous Stone Statue.

Popo is a steward that is one of the trainees during the quests Training Our Forces (Kyrian), Training in Maldraxxus (Kyrian), Training in Revendreth (Kyrian), and Training in Ardenweald (Kyrian). She is also located in northern Bastion. Later she is encountered during Wild Worldcracker vignette in Korthia.

Pop Quiz is a Korthian vignette which starts at several locations in Korthia. An objective of Conquering Korthia, interact with the Abandoned Veilstaff and Ve'rayn pops out: : Defeat her for ~10-12x Relic Fragment, ~13-18 uncommon-quality anima items (65-90 anima), and Ve'rayn's Head (item), which starts Ve'rayn's Head. Find the staff in an out-of-the-way spot at one of the following: * Estuary of Awakening * Mauler's Outlook * Path of Understanding * SW Seeker's Quorum * NW Vault of Secrets
